reason: I already turn to free ChatGPT on my phone when I get anxious and need to vent late at night. On a student budget, I can't justify paying a monthly subscription for something I already get for free.
objection: Free ChatGPT or Claude can already chat with me for free, so paying $10 a month feels redundant.
would_change_my_mind: A solid free tier for late-night grounding or student pricing around $2-$3 a month with proof that DBT exercises help way more than general chat.
